chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. With stringed instruments. By David.

verses.text: Hear my cry, God. Listen to my prayer.
From di end of di earth I go call to you, when my heart dey overwhelmed. Lead me to di rock wey high pass me.
Because you don be refuge for me, strong tower from di enemy.
I go dwell for your tent forever. I go take refuge for di shelter of your wings. Selah.
Because you, God, don hear my vows. You don give me di inheritance of dem wey fear your name.
You go add days to di king life. Im years go be like many generations.
E go dey before God forever. Appoint faithful love and truth to preserve am.
So I go sing praise to your name forever, as I dey pay my vows every day.

chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. For Jeduthun. A Psalm by David.

verses.text: My soul wait in silence for God only. My salvation dey come from am.
E only na my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I no go shake well well.
How long una go attack man, all of una, to throw am down, like leaning wall, like shaking fence?
Dem only plan to throw am down from im high place. Dem dey delight for lies. Dem dey bless with dem mouth, but inside dem dey curse. Selah.
My soul, wait in silence for God only, because my hope dey come from am.
E only na my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I no go shake.
My salvation and my honor dey depend on God. My rock of strength and my refuge dey for God.
Trust am at all times, una people. Pour out your heart before am. God na refuge for us. Selah.
Sure sure men of low degree na breath, and men of high degree na lie. For di scale dem go go up. Dem lighter pass breath.
No trust for oppression. No hope vain for robbery. If riches increase, no set your heart on dem.
God don talk one time. Two times I don hear dis: say power belong to God.
Also to you, Lord, belong faithful love, because you dey pay back every man according to im work.

chapters.title: A Psalm by David, when e dey for di wilderness of Judah.

verses.text: God, you be my God. I go seek you earnestly. My soul dey thirst for you. My flesh dey long for you, for dry and weary land, where no water dey.
So I don look for you for di sanctuary, to see your power and your glory.
Because your faithful love better pass life. My lips go praise you.
So I go bless you as long as I dey alive. I go lift up my hands for your name.
My soul go satisfy as with fat and rich food. My mouth go praise you with joyful lips,
when I remember you for my bed and think about you for di night watches.
Because you don be my help. For di shadow of your wings I go rejoice.
My soul dey follow close after you. Your right hand dey hold me up.
But dem wey seek my soul to destroy am go go down into di lower parts of di earth.
Dem go give dem to di power of di sword. Dem go be food for jackals.
But di king go rejoice for God. Everyone wey swear by am go glory, because di mouth of dem wey speak lies go stop.

chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. A Psalm by David.

verses.text: Hear my voice, God, for my complaint. Preserve my life from fear of di enemy.
Hide me from di secret plots of di wicked, from di noisy crowd of evildoers,
wey sharpen dem tongue like sword and aim dem arrows, bitter words,
to shoot for secret places at di blameless. Sudden dem shoot am and no fear.
Dem encourage dem self for evil plan. Dem talk about how to hide snares. Dem talk say, “Who go see dem?”
Dem plan injustices. “We don finish di perfect plan.” Di inward thought and heart of man dey deep.
But God go shoot dem with arrow. Sudden dem go dey wounded.
Dem go make dem own tongue fall on dem self. All wey see dem go shake dem head.
All men go fear. Dem go declare di work of God and consider wetin e don do.
Di righteous go be glad for di Lord and take refuge for am. All di upright for heart go glory.

chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. A song.

verses.text: Praise dey wait for you, God, for Zion. Di vow go dey paid to you.
You wey hear prayer, all flesh go come to you.
Iniquities don overwhelm me, but you go forgive our transgressions.
Blessed na di one wey you choose and bring near, so dat e go dwell for your courts. We go dey satisfied with di goodness of your house, your holy temple.
By awesome deeds you go answer us for righteousness, God of our salvation, you wey be di hope of all di ends of di earth and of di farthest seas.
You wey set fast di mountains by your power, wey don gird yourself with strength,
wey quiet di roaring of di seas, di roaring of dem waves and di tumult of di peoples.
Dem wey dey live far away dey fear your signs. You make di morning and evening dey sing for joy.
You visit di earth and water am. You enrich am greatly. Di river of God full of water. You provide dem grain, because na so you don prepare di earth.
You water im furrows abundantly. You settle im ridges. You soften am with showers. You bless im growth.
You crown di year with your bounty. Your carts overflow with abundance.
Di pastures of di wilderness overflow. Di hills dey clothe dem self with joy.
Di meadows dey clothe dem self with flocks. Di valleys dey covered with grain. Dem shout for joy. Yes, dem sing.

chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. A song. A Psalm.

verses.text: Shout for joy to God, all di earth!
Sing di glory of im name. Make im praise glorious.
Talk to God say, “How awesome your works dey! Through di greatness of your power, your enemies go submit to you.
All di earth go worship you and go sing praises to you. Dem go sing praises to your name.” Selah.
Come and see di works of God, awesome for im deeds toward di pikin dem of men.
E turn di sea into dry land. Dem pass through di river on foot. Dere we rejoice for am.
E rule by im power forever. Im eyes dey watch di nations. No make di rebellious lift up dem self. Selah.
Bless our God, una peoples. Make di sound of im praise dey heard,
wey keep our soul alive and no allow our feet to slip.
Because you, God, don test us. You don refine us as silver dey refined.
You bring us into di net. You lay burden on our back.
You make men ride over our heads. We pass through fire and through water, but you bring us out to abundance.
I go come into your house with burnt offerings. I go pay you my vows,
wey my lips utter and my mouth speak when I dey for trouble.
I go offer to you burnt offerings of fat animals, with di smoke of rams. I go offer bulls with goats. Selah.
Come and hear, all una wey fear God, and I go declare wetin e don do for my soul.
I cry to am with my mouth. Praise dey under my tongue.
If I don hold sin for my heart, di Lord no go hear.
But sure sure God don hear. E don listen to di voice of my prayer.
Blessed be God, wey no turn away my prayer or im faithful love from me.

chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. With stringed instruments. A Psalm. A song.

verses.text: God, have mercy on us and bless us, and make your face shine on us. Selah.
So dat your way go known for di earth, and your salvation among all nations.
Make di peoples praise you, God. Make all di peoples praise you.
Oh make di nations be glad and sing for joy, because you go judge di peoples with fairness and guide di nations for di earth. Selah.
Make di peoples praise you, God. Make all di peoples praise you.
Di earth don yield im increase. God, even our own God, go bless us.
God go bless us. All di ends of di earth go fear am.

chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. By David. A Psalm. A song.

verses.text: Make God arise, make im enemies scatter. Make dem wey hate am run from im presence.
As smoke dey driven away, so drive dem away. As wax dey melt before fire, so make di wicked perish before God.
But make di righteous be glad. Make dem rejoice before God. Yes, make dem rejoice with gladness.
Sing to God, sing praises to im name. Make way for am wey ride through di desert. Im name na Yah. Rejoice before am.
Papa to di orphans and defender of widows na God for im holy home.
God dey set di lonely for families. E dey bring out prisoners into prosperity, but di rebellious dey live for dry land.
God, when you go out before your people, when you march through di wilderness, Selah,
di earth shake. Di heavens also drop rain at di presence of God. Dis Sinai quake at di presence of God, di God of Israel.
You, God, send plenty rain. You confirm your inheritance, when e dey weary.
Your congregation settle for am. You, God, provide for di poor from your goodness.
Di Lord announce di word. Di women wey dey tell di news na great army.
Kings of armies dey flee, dey flee. Di woman wey dey stay for home dey share di spoil.
Though you lie among di sheepfolds, una be like wings of dove covered with silver, im feathers with yellow gold.
When di Almighty scatter kings for am, e snow for Zalmon.
Di mountain of Bashan na mountain of God. Di mountain of Bashan get many peaks.
Why una dey look with envy, una mountains wey get many peaks, at di mountain wey God desire for im home? Yes, di Lord go dwell dere forever.
Di chariots of God na tens of thousands and thousands of thousands. Di Lord dey among dem, from Sinai for holiness.
You don go up on high. You don lead captives away. You don receive gifts among men, yes, even among di rebellious, so dat di Lord God go dwell dere.
Blessed be di Lord, wey dey load us with benefits every day, di God of our salvation. Selah.
God na God of salvation for us. To di Lord God belong di ways of escape from death.
But God go strike through di head of im enemies, di hairy scalp of am wey continue for im guilt.
Di Lord talk say, “I go bring dem back from Bashan. I go bring dem back from di depths of di sea,
so dat your foot go crush dem for blood, and di tongues of your dogs go get dem share of your enemies.”
Dem don see your processions, God, di processions of my God, my King, into di sanctuary.
Di singers go first, di musicians follow after, among di young women wey dey play tambourines.
Bless God for di congregations, di Lord, una wey be from di fountain of Israel.
Dere dey small Benjamin, dem ruler, di princes of Judah dem company, di princes of Zebulun and di princes of Naphtali.
Your God don command your strength. Show your strength, God, wey you don work for us.
Because of your temple for Jerusalem, kings go bring gifts to you.
Rebuke di wild animal for di reeds, di herd of bulls with di calves of di peoples. Trample under foot dem wey love silver. Scatter di peoples wey delight for war.
Princes go come out of Egypt. Ethiopia go quickly stretch out im hands to God.
Sing to God, una kingdoms of di earth. Sing praises to di Lord. Selah.
To am wey ride on di heavens, di ancient heavens. Look, e dey send out im voice, mighty voice.
Ascribe strength to God. Im majesty dey over Israel, and im strength dey for di skies.
You dey awesome, God, from your sanctuary. Di God of Israel give strength and power to im people. Blessed be God!

chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. To di tune of Lilies. By David.

verses.text: Save me, God, because di waters don come up to my neck.
I dey sink for deep mud, where no foothold dey. I don come into deep waters, where di floods dey overflow me.
I don tire from my crying. My throat dry. My eyes fail while I dey wait for my God.
Dem wey hate me for no reason pass di hairs of my head. Dem wey wan destroy me, wey be my enemies without cause, strong. Wetin I no steal, I must restore.
God, you know my foolishness. My wrongs no hide from you.
No make dem wey wait for you, Lord God of Armies, shame because of me. No make dem wey seek you dey disgraced because of me, God of Israel.
Because for your sake I don bear reproach. Shame don cover my face.
I don become stranger to my brothers and foreigner to my mama pikin dem.
Because zeal for your house don eat me up. Di reproaches of dem wey reproach you don fall on me.
When I weep and fast, dem make dat my reproach.
When I make sackcloth my clothing, I become proverb to dem.
Dem wey sit for di gate dey talk about me. I be song of drunkards.
But as for me, my prayer na to you, Lord, for acceptable time. God, for di abundance of your faithful love, answer me for di truth of your salvation.
Rescue me out of di mud, and no let me sink. Make I dey delivered from dem wey hate me and out of di deep waters.
No let di flood waters overwhelm me, or di deep swallow me up, or di pit close im mouth on me.
Answer me, Lord, because your faithful love good. Turn to me according to di abundance of your tender mercies.
No hide your face from your servant, because I dey for trouble. Answer me quick.
Draw near to my soul and redeem am. Ransom me because of my enemies.
You know my reproach, my shame and my disgrace. All my adversaries dey before you.
Reproach don break my heart, and I dey despair. I look for sympathy, but nobody dey. I look for comforters, but I no find any.
Dem put poison for my food. For my thirst dem give me vinegar to drink.
Make dem table before dem become snare. Make am become trap for dem wey dey at peace.
Make dem eyes dark so dat dem no go see. Make dem loins shake always.
Pour out your indignation on dem. Make your burning anger overtake dem.
Make dem camp dey desolate. Make nobody dey dem tents.
Because dem persecute di one wey you don strike, and dem talk about di pain of dem wey you don wound.
Add iniquity to dem iniquity. No let dem come into your righteousness.
Make dem blot out from di book of life and no write dem with di righteous.
But I dey poor and sorrowful. Make your salvation, God, set me up on high.
I go praise God name with song and magnify am with thanksgiving.
E go please di Lord pass ox or bull wey get horns and hooves.
Di humble don see am and dem glad. Una wey seek God, make your heart live.
Because di Lord dey hear di needy and no dey despise im prisoners.
Make heaven and earth praise am, di seas and everything wey dey move inside dem.
Because God go save Zion and build di cities of Judah. Dem go dwell dere and possess am.
Di pikin dem of im servants go inherit am. Dem wey love im name go dwell inside am.

chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. By David. To bring to remembrance.

verses.text: Hurry to deliver me, God. Hurry to help me, Lord.
Make dem shame and confuse, dem wey seek my soul. Make dem turn back and dishonored, dem wey delight for my hurt.
Make dem turn back because of dem shame, dem wey talk say, “Aha! Aha!”
Make all dem wey seek you rejoice and be glad for you. Make dem wey love your salvation always talk say, “Make God dey magnified!”
But I dey poor and needy. Come to me quick, God. You be my help and my deliverer. Lord, no delay.
